name: Rondo ◆Punyupuri Joshikou Hen◆
original_name: 輪舞曲◆ぷにゅぷり女子高編◆
source:
A rumor had spread in the girls high school. You will be caught by the devil if being in classroom alone after school.....
But it is not just a rumor! The Devil does exist!!
Girls who met the devil were put under a spell and the only way out is to have sex with someone...
